title: From silicon to synapse: Why the artificial unit is not a kind of neuron
title_zh: 从硅到突触：为何人工单元并非神经元
abstract: The computational units of large language models (LLMs)-artificial neurons, attention heads, and weight matrices-differ from biological neurons not merely in degree but in kind. This paper develops that empirical argument across three levels of biological organization: the single neuron, the local circuit, and whole-brain dynamics. At the single-neuron level, biological neurons are self-maintaining electrochemical processes sustained by continuous ATP-dependent ion pumping, activity-dependent morphological remodeling, and spike-timing-dependent plasticity (STDP) grounded in local calcium dynamics at individual synapses; artificial units are stateless, memoryless scalar transformations with no metabolic basis. At the circuit level, cortical columns implement laminar excitatory-inhibitory balance and self-organized collective oscillatory dynamics that are absent from the feedforward, batch-normalized layer stacks of transformer architectures. At the systems level, the brain sustains always-on intrinsic dynamics, homeostatic regulation, and circadian entrainment; LLMs are stateless between inferences and possess no equivalent of resting-state activity. Across all three levels, the differences are organizational rather than scalar: they concern the mode of existence of the processing units, not merely the quantity or speed of processing. We conclude that the term "artificial neuron" is a historical metaphor that has outlived its usefulness as a scientific description, and that the conflation of artificial units with biological neurons is a source of persistent confusion in both AI research and public understanding. Replacing the metaphor with precise empirical description is a precondition for accurate evaluation of what LLMs can and cannot do.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）的计算单元——人工神经元、注意力头和权重矩阵——在本质上与生物神经元不同，而不仅仅是程度上的差异。本文在生物组织的三个层面展开这一经验论证：单个神经元、局部回路和全脑动力学。单个神经元层面，生物神经元是自我维持的电化学过程，依赖持续的ATP驱动离子泵、活动相关的形态重塑以及基于单个突触局部钙动力学的尖峰时序依赖性可塑性（STDP）；人工单元则是无状态、无记忆的标量变换，缺乏代谢基础。在回路层面，皮层柱实现层级的兴奋-抑制平衡和自组织的集体振荡动力学，而变压器架构的前馈、批量归一化层堆叠中缺乏这些特征。在系统层面，大脑维持持续的内在动力学、稳态调节和昼夜节律同步；LLMs 在推理之间无状态，且没有相当于静息态活动的机制。在这三个层面上，差异是组织性的而非标量的：它们涉及处理单元的存在方式，而不仅仅是处理的数量或速度。我们得出结论，术语“人工神经元”是一个已过时的历史隐喻，已不再适合作为科学描述；将人工单元与生物神经元混为一谈是导致 AI 研究和公众理解持续混乱的根源。用精确的经验描述取代隐喻是准确评估 LLM 能做与不能做的前提。
